Heroic Epic Integration
=======================

OmniLibrary can download Heroic Epic Integration v0.4 on demand for Epic-owned
Rockstar games. It supplies the EpicGamesLauncher.exe compatibility process
Rockstar uses to detect Epic ownership. It is not embedded in the Tools for
Steam source tree or installer.

Project: https://github.com/Etaash-mathamsetty/heroic-epic-integration
Release asset:
https://github.com/Etaash-mathamsetty/heroic-epic-integration/releases/download/v0.4/EpicGamesLauncher.exe
Expected SHA-256:
1feb21e21e19cbb34e881791c8f2557769f59231e46850915d49a6d0c1ce4583
License: MIT
